headline: Indian growers work toward home-grown strawberry varieties
summary: BBC reports farmers want less reliance on imported US and European varieties; recent Indian research tests protected cultivation and yield improvements.
script: Indian growers are testing protected cultivation and local strawberry varieties to reduce reliance on imported plants. The country wants to join the world’s strawberry leaders, while improved growing methods are producing higher yields in trials.
imageAlt: Large red strawberries packed in a box.
imageAltTwo: Strawberry plants grow in raised grey tubes inside a protected farm.
